data_card.measured: Maximum water levels surveyed after the 1959 Malpasset dam failure, and arrival times and maximum levels at 9 points in the 1:400 physical model built in 1964.
data_card.method: Post-event survey of high-water marks; physical-model gauges.
data_card.uncertainty: Not yet stated: the value in reference.uncertainty is a placeholder until the published gauge or survey error is recorded.
known_issues: The original topography is CADAM/EDF data with unconfirmed redistribution terms.
The physical model, not the field event, provides the arrival times.
data_card.exercises: A dam-break wave over steep, irregular, dry terrain: wetting and drying, shock capturing and the flood's arrival time.
data_card.cannot_tell: High-water marks are maxima: they say nothing about how the level rose and fell. Breach timing and topography uncertainty limit how close any model can get.

title: Malpasset 1959 dam failure
